profile.name: Rudra Tiwari
profile.role: Founder, Catalyst | Building AI systems for scientific discovery
profile.bio: I build Catalyst, an AI-native scientific discovery workspace for materials research, alongside original ML research and public software. Winner at the OpenAI International Codex Hackathon, I care about systems that survive beyond the demo.
profile.status: Open to research conversations and collaborations

about.title: About
body: I build public systems for scientific discovery, practical AI, and software that has to keep working after launch day. My flagship work is Catalyst, an AI-native workspace that turns scattered scientific evidence into clearer material-discovery decisions.

Alongside product work, I research small-data materials ML through TRIADS, contribute to OpenAI Parameter Golf, and maintain open-source software such as Shippy. I like hard technical problems, but I like shipping useful things even more.
Away from the terminal, I build RC planes and PCs, make music and videos, and keep finding rabbit holes that are far too interesting to leave alone.

focus.v: Catalyst, evidence-driven research workflows, and materials discovery.
Shippy maintenance, Parameter Golf, and open-source building.

work.title: Work
work.lede: Scientific AI, materials ML, and public software built to hold up outside the demo.

featured.name: Catalyst
featured.desc: An AI-native scientific discovery workspace for materials research. Catalyst connects literature, datasets, evidence graphs, structure and property inspection, spectra, candidate comparison, project memory, and agent workflows.

featured.name: TRIADS
featured.desc: A parameter-efficient recursive attention architecture for materials-property prediction in small-data regimes. Code, pretrained weights, and benchmark results are paired with a Zenodo preprint.

featured.name: Shippy
featured.desc: Open-source Android music app built in Kotlin. I maintain architecture, playback and library experience, and the long-term bug-fixing work that turns a codebase into a product.

featured.name: Parameter Golf
featured.desc: OpenAI Parameter Golf work: small LM training, compression constraints, and PR-frontier analysis under the 16MB limit.

archive.name: ANCP
archive.desc: Agent Native Compiler Protocol: a spec-first, machine-readable interface for compiler diagnostics, repair plans, safe fixes, and verification loops across languages.

archive.name: ALB
archive.desc: Universal model gateway and provider load balancer for Codex-style agent clients.

archive.name: BloodGrid
archive.desc: Local-first regional blood-network simulation and decision-support workspace for Jharkhand.

archive.name: Agentic Provider Gateway
archive.desc: Provider-agnostic model infrastructure: routing, adapters, capability metadata, structured outputs, normalized tool calls, streaming, usage accounting, trace storage.

archive.name: Agentic Skills
archive.desc: High-agency agent skills for executable specs and end-to-end shipping, forming the public skill layer behind clearer planning and ship-ready workflows.

archive.name: Munchkin
archive.desc: Cross-platform multi-account manager for Codex, Gemini, and Qwen CLIs with encrypted storage, fast switching, quota tracking, and load balancing.

archive.name: supergit
archive.desc: Lightweight terminal Git assistant: init, commits, sync, branch switching, and undo flows with guided prompts and safer defaults.

archive.name: Piko
archive.desc: Tiny AI focus companion for Chrome. Lightweight, focused, and easy to try.

archive.name: Meow-Mocks
archive.desc: Web-based mock test platform driven by JSON exam definitions: timed exams, review flow, results breakdowns, analysis views.

archive.name: YouTube TLDR
archive.desc: Distraction-blocking Chrome extension that redirects YouTube viewing into an AI-generated summary first.
